en: An old monochrome postcard view of three villas in a rural, forested valley. In the foreground is a road and a low stone wall; behind it stand three separate houses labeled as villas, with dense coniferous forest and low hills in the background. The architectural style suggests late 19th to early 20th century Central Europe. Red printed captions in German identify each villa, and a greeting line is printed at the top.
